lines.say: Does the mind-muscle connection really work?
It means thinking hard about the muscle you're training, while you lift.
Studies show it works. When people focus on the muscle, sensors on the skin pick up more activity in it.
In one study, people who focused on their biceps during curls grew them almost twice as much as people who just lifted.
But it only worked with light and medium weights. On very heavy sets, focus on moving the weight.
So on curls, flys and raises, slow down, squeeze, and feel the muscle work.
On your heavy squats and deadlifts, just lift well.
Next: full reps or half reps?
